Cinematic still from a Pixar-style 3D animated film. Soft warm cinematic lighting, gentle depth of field, rich glossy materials, storybook charm. A lush enchanted forest world under a bright candy-blue sky with puffy white clouds: giant friendly trees, mossy ground, winding stone paths, oversized mushrooms, drifting dandelion sparkles and tiny glowing fireflies. Cohesive color palette of star gold #FFC93C, sky blue #5BB8F0, crash pink #E84A9B, party purple #8B5CF6, confetti green #4CC96B, cream #FFF4E0. Highly detailed, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. Tall vertical portrait composition, focal subject centered, nothing important cropped at the edges.
Subject: a wide magical establishing shot of the enchanted forest with a small cozy storybook cottage in a sunlit clearing at its center, seen from slightly above between the tall friendly trees, a winding stone path leading from the foreground down to its front door. The cottage is warm and inviting — honey-toned wooden walls, a simple shingled roof, a thin wisp of chimney smoke, flower boxes under the windows, a little fenced yard with a mailbox. Through its big warm-lit front window a small, quiet birthday party is just visible in miniature: a small Pixar-style boy with round cheeks and soft brown hair sitting at a table with a simple birthday cake and a couple of balloons, chin in hands, looking kinda bored, staring wistfully at a little golden star toy figure standing on the table beside the cake. Composition guides the eye from the treetops down the path to the glowing front window.
